```{r, warning = FALSE, comment = "", message = FALSE}
library(RNAAgeCalc)
library(readr)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)
library(writexl)


wtc_prostate_rna = read.csv("RNAseq_WTC_prostate.csv")
rownames(wtc_prostate_rna) = wtc_prostate_rna[[1]]
wtc_prostate_rna = wtc_prostate_rna[ , -1]

prostate_full = read_excel("prostate_full.xlsx")

prostate_chron_age = 
  prostate_full[c("Subject in first DNA/ RNA study", "Age")] %>% 
  na.omit(prostate_full) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(sample_id = "Subject in first DNA/ RNA study") %>% 
  dplyr::rename(chron_age = "Age") 

prostate_chron_age$sample_id = toupper(prostate_chron_age$sample_id) 
                                            
missing_rows = data.frame(
  sample_id = c("W2", "W13", "C7"),
  chron_age = c(59, 52, 59)
)

prostate_chron_age = rbind(prostate_chron_age, missing_rows)

valid_ids = colnames(wtc_prostate_rna)          
prostate_chron_age = subset(prostate_chron_age, sample_id %in% valid_ids) 
```

```{r, warning = FALSE, comment = ""}
bio_age_prostate = predict_age(exprdata = wtc_prostate_rna, tissue = "prostate",
                               exprtype = "FPKM", idtype = "SYMBOL", stype = 
                                "all", chronage = 
                                 as.data.frame(prostate_chron_age))
  
  
  
library(writexl)
library(openxlsx)

kable(bio_age_prostate, col.names = c("Transcriptional Age", "Chronological Age"), 
                                    format = "markdown", caption = "Transcriptional Age Table")
```

```{r, warning = FALSE, comment = ""} 

mean_bage_wtc = 
  mean(bio_age_prostate$RNAAge[startsWith(rownames(bio_age_prostate), "W")], 
       na.rm = TRUE)

mean_bage_cont = 
  mean(bio_age_prostate$RNAAge[startsWith(rownames(bio_age_prostate), "C")],
       na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r, warning = FALSE, comment = ""}
mean_cage_wtc =

       na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r, warning = FALSE, comment = ""}
mean_age_tb = data.frame(
                  population = c("WTC Responders", "Control Group"),
                  avg_chronological_age_years = 
                    c(mean_cage_wtc, mean_cage_cont),
                  avg_transcriptional_age_years = 
                    c(mean_bage_wtc, mean_bage_cont),
                  difference = c(mean_bage_wtc, mean_bage_cont) -

)
```

```{r}
prostate_samples <- prostate_full %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(`Subject in first DNA/ RNA study`)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(`Subject in first DNA/ RNA study`, `WTC#`, Age, Race, `Gleason score`) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    race_binary = case_when(
      Race %in% c("w", "nhw") ~ "White",
      is.na(Race) ~ "Missing",
      TRUE ~ "Non-White"
    )
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-Race) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(subject_id = `Subject in first DNA/ RNA study`) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    group = case_when(
      startsWith(toupper(subject_id), "W") ~ "WTC Exposed",
      startsWith(toupper(subject_id), "C") ~ "WTC Unexposed",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

prostate_samples <- prostate_samples %>%
  dplyr::mutate(subject_id = toupper(subject_id)) 

prostate_samples <- prostate_samples %>%
  add_row(
    subject_id = "W2",
    `WTC#` = "W06523",
    Age = 59,
    `Gleason score` = NA,
    race_binary = "Missing",
    group = "WTC Exposed"
  ) %>% 
  add_row(
    subject_id = "W13",
    `WTC#` = "W51120",
    Age = 52,
    `Gleason score` = NA,
    race_binary = "White",
    group = "WTC Exposed"
  ) %>% 
  add_row(
    subject_id = "C7",
    `WTC#` = "NA",
    Age = 59,
    `Gleason score` = NA,
    race_binary = "Missing",
    group = "WTC Unexposed"
  )


prostate_samples_with_rna = names(wtc_prostate_rna)
prostate_samples = prostate_samples %>% 
  dplyr::filter(subject_id %in% prostate_samples_with_rna)

prostate_samples <- prostate_samples %>%
  mutate(
    `Gleason score` = case_when(
      is.na(`Gleason score`) ~ "Missing",
      TRUE ~ as.character(`Gleason score`)
    )
  )
prostate_samples$race_binary[
  prostate_samples$subject_id == "W2"
] <- "Non-White" 
prostate_samples$`Gleason score`[
  prostate_samples$subject_id == "W2"
] <- "7"
prostate_samples$race_binary[
  prostate_samples$subject_id == "W13"
] <- "White" 
prostate_samples$`Gleason score`[
  prostate_samples$subject_id == "W13"
] <- "6"
prostate_samples$race_binary[
  prostate_samples$subject_id == "W14"
] <- "White" 
prostate_samples$race_binary[
  prostate_samples$subject_id == "W10"
] <- "White" 

prostate_samples <- prostate_samples %>%
  mutate(
    `Gleason score` = case_when(
      `Gleason score` %in% c("8", "9") ~ "8–9",
      TRUE ~ `Gleason score`
    )
  )

prostate_samples <- prostate_samples %>%
  mutate(
    race_binary = factor(
      race_binary,
      levels = c("White", "Non-White", "Missing")
    )
  )

library(gtsummary)
library(flextable)
library(officer)

prostate_gtsum = prostate_samples %>%
  dplyr::select(
    group,
    Age,
    `Gleason score`,
    race_binary
  ) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = group,
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})"
    ),
    digits = list(
      all_continuous() ~ 1
    ),
    label = list(
      Age ~ "Age at Diagnosis (years)",
      `Gleason score` ~ "Gleason Score",
      race_binary ~ "Race, n (%)"
    )
  ) %>%
  add_p(
    test = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "t.test",
      all_categorical() ~ "fisher.test"
    )
  ) %>%
  modify_header(
    list(
      stat_1 ~ "**WTC Exposed** N = {n}",
      stat_2 ~ "**WTC Unexposed** N = {n}"
    )
  ) %>%
  bold_labels()
```

```{r}
gleason_new = prostate_full %>% 
  dplyr::select(`Subject in first DNA/ RNA study`, `Gleason score`) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(`Subject in first DNA/ RNA study`)) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(subject_id = `Subject in first DNA/ RNA study`, gleason = `Gleason score`)
gleason_new$subject_id <- toupper(gleason_new$subject_id)


prostate_trans_age = prostate_trans_age %>% 
  dplyr::rename(subject_id = sample_id)

gleason_accel_new = left_join(
  prostate_trans_age, 
  gleason_new, 
  by = "subject_id"
)

gleason_accel_new$gleason[
  gleason_accel_new$subject_id == "W2"
] = 7
gleason_accel_new$gleason[
  gleason_accel_new$subject_id == "W13"
] = 6

gleason_accel_new = gleason_accel_new %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(gleason))

ggplot(gleason_accel_new, aes(x = gleason, y = AgeAccelResid)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = exposure), size = 0.8, inherit.aes = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("WTC Responder" = "red", "Control" = "blue"),
    labels = c("WTC Responder" = "WTC-exposed",
               "Control" = "WTC-unexposed")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Gleason score",
    y = "Aging Acceleration",
    title = "Gleason Score vs Aging Acceleration in Prostate Cancer Tissue"
  )
```

# build full prostate subjects clinical dataset including all missing values and save for future use
```{r}
final_prostate_clinical = prostate_full %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(`Subject in first DNA/ RNA study`))
final_prostate_clinical$`Subject in first DNA/ RNA study` = toupper(final_prostate_clinical$`Subject in first DNA/ RNA study`)
final_prostate_clinical = final_prostate_clinical %>% 
  dplyr::select(`Subject in first DNA/ RNA study`, `WTC#`, Age, Race, `Gleason score`) %>% 
  mutate(
    Race = case_when(
      Race == "h"   ~ "Hispanic",
      Race == "w"   ~ "White",
      Race == "nhw" ~ "White",
      Race == "B"   ~ "Black",
      Race == "Indian" ~ "Indian",
      is.na(Race)   ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ Race
    )
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(subject_id = `Subject in first DNA/ RNA study`, age_at_diag = Age, race = Race, gleason = `Gleason score`) %>% 
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      startsWith(subject_id, "C") ~ "Control",
      startsWith(subject_id, "W") ~ "WTC Responder",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(gleason = as.numeric(gleason))



# add missing rows for W2, W13, and C7

final_prostate_clinical <- final_prostate_clinical %>%
  add_row(
    subject_id = "W2",
    `WTC#` = "W06523",
    age_at_diag = 59,
    gleason = 7,
    race = "Black",
    group = "WTC Responder"
  ) %>% 
  add_row(
    subject_id = "W13",
    `WTC#` = "W51120",
    age_at_diag = 52,
    gleason = 6,
    race = "White",
    group = "WTC Responder"
  ) %>% 
  add_row(
    subject_id = "C7",
    `WTC#` = "NA",
    age_at_diag = 59,
    gleason = NA,
    race = "Missing",
    group = "Control"
  )

final_prostate_clinical$race[
  final_prostate_clinical$subject_id == "W10"
] = "White"
final_prostate_clinical$race[
  final_prostate_clinical$subject_id == "W14"
] = "White"
final_prostate_clinical$race[
  final_prostate_clinical$subject_id == "W9"
] = "White"

# write.csv(final_prostate_clinical, "final_prostate_clinical.csv")
```

# gleason score vs. exposure level 
```{r}
prostate_cases_exp = prostate_exposure %>% 
  dplyr::select(subject_id, EXP4) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!EXP4 == "")

# merge clinical data w exposure levels
# ensure consistent ID formatting
final_prostate_clinical$subject_id <- toupper(final_prostate_clinical$subject_id)

prostate_cases_exp <- prostate_cases_exp %>%
  dplyr::mutate(subject_id = toupper(subject_id))

# build exposure_level
final_prostate_clinical <- final_prostate_clinical %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    prostate_cases_exp %>%
      dplyr::select(subject_id, EXP4),
    by = "subject_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    exposure_level = case_when(
      group == "Control" ~ "None",
      group == "WTC Responder" & !is.na(EXP4) ~ EXP4,
      group == "WTC Responder" & is.na(EXP4) ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )


# remove NA exposure level and gleason rows for plotting purposes
prostate_gleason_exp_plot = final_prostate_clinical %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(exposure_level)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(gleason))

# plot 
ggplot(prostate_gleason_exp_plot, aes(x = exposure_level, fill = factor(gleason))) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(
    x = "WTC Exposure Level",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "Gleason Score",
    title = "Gleason Score Distribution by WTC Exposure Level"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```



# 7/29/2026 -- updating the aging manuscript for the reviewers comments and I can't find the code for my original gleason x aging acceleration boxplot with points colored for the different levels of WTC exposure, so recreating it to change the label of the key 
```{r}
# Join aging acceleration with Gleason score and WTC exposure intensity
prostate_accel_gleason_plot <- prostate_trans_age %>%
  dplyr::select(subject_id, AgeAccelResid) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    final_prostate_clinical %>%
      dplyr::select(subject_id, gleason, exposure_level),
    by = "subject_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(AgeAccelResid),
    !is.na(gleason),
    !is.na(exposure_level)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    
    # Collapse Gleason scores 8 and 9
    gleason_collapsed = dplyr::case_when(
      gleason %in% c(8, 9) ~ "8–9",
      TRUE ~ as.character(gleason)
    ),
    
    gleason_collapsed = factor(
      gleason_collapsed,
      levels = c("6", "7", "8–9")
    ),
    
    # Collapse High and Very High exposure
    exposure_collapsed = dplyr::case_when(
      exposure_level %in% c("High", "Very High") ~ "High/Very High",
      TRUE ~ as.character(exposure_level)
    ),
    
    exposure_collapsed = factor(
      exposure_collapsed,
      levels = c("None", "Intermediate", "High/Very High")
    )
  )


# Make jitter reproducible
set.seed(2026)

p = ggplot(
  prostate_accel_gleason_plot,
  aes(x = gleason_collapsed, y = AgeAccelResid)
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    fill = "lightgrey",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = exposure_collapsed),
    width = 0.12,
    height = 0,
    size = 0.75,
    alpha = 1
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "None" = "skyblue3",
      "Intermediate" = "maroon4",
      "High/Very High" = "red"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Gleason Score",
    y = "Aging Acceleration",
    color = "WTC Exposure Intensity"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```
